title: Ilustración de Acuarela de Libro Infantil Caprichoso: Escena Acogedora de Zorro Nórdico Invernal

Composition is simple with comfortable white space and a clear, prominent main character. No photographic texture, no 3D rendered feel, no overly sharp details. No watermarks or logos. Subject: A cozy winter scene in Stockholm featuring a Nordic fox wearing a knitted scarf, sitting in falling snow near traditional Swedish red wooden houses.
